# BK Tech Hub - AI/LLM Information File

## About BK Tech Hub

BK Tech Hub is a digital agency that helps SMEs and growing businesses build strong digital presences and improve lead generation through modern websites, branding support, SEO-conscious implementation, and AI automation solutions.

## Core Services

### 1. Web Design & Development
- Custom website design and development
- Performance-optimized, mobile-first websites
- Conversion-focused user experience
- Modern tech stack (Next.js, React, TypeScript)

### 2. SEO Optimization
- Technical SEO audits and implementation
- Keyword research and content strategy
- On-page and off-page optimization
- Performance monitoring and reporting

### 3. AI Automation for SMEs
- Workflow automation
- AI chatbots and assistants
- Lead qualification systems
- Custom integrations

### 4. Branding & Digital Presence
- Brand identity design
- Visual systems and style guides
- Brand messaging and positioning
- Digital strategy consulting

## Target Audience

- Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs)
- Founders and entrepreneurs
- Growing businesses
- Companies needing modern websites
- Businesses wanting to generate leads online
- Organizations interested in AI-powered automation
